bypasses.name: TC-GUARD-001 OR Logic
bypasses.mechanism: ONE OF {gap_ledger_ref, capability_ref, spec_fact_refs} satisfies the guard. gap_ledger_ref alone is sufficient.
bypasses.impact: 100% of product sprints can pass TC-GUARD-001 with zero spec authority citations
bypasses.live_evidence: zst-frame-count-coverage-20260622 sprint: spec_fact_refs=null, gap_ledger_ref present, verdict=ACCEPTED
bypasses.repair: Change OR to AND — require gap_ledger_ref AND (spec_fact_refs OR exception_classification)

bypasses.name: V13 Absent-vs-Invalid Distinction
bypasses.mechanism: V13 only fires when spec_fact_refs is PROVIDED AND INVALID. Absent field evaluates to False — no enforcement.
bypasses.impact: Workers can submit evidence with no spec_fact_refs for Tier 1 formats and V13 won't fire
bypasses.live_evidence: Any FODS sprint without spec_fact_refs in evidence declaration — V13 does not block
bypasses.repair: Add ABSENT check: fire V13 when spec_fact_refs absent AND no exception_classification AND PRODUCT_SOURCE AND Tier 1 format

bypasses.name: product_task_selector poc-targets Binary Check
bypasses.mechanism: Checks poc-targets.yaml membership only (binary ALLOWED/BLOCKED). Never calls authority_gate_validation.py. Hard-coded _CANDIDATE_CATALOG bypasses gate entirely for Gnumeric/ABW.
bypasses.impact: P1 formats (Gnumeric, ABW) receive product expansion tasks. P2 formats (CSV, NDJSON, TOML) also receive tasks regardless of authority level.
bypasses.live_evidence: authority_gate_validation.py returns P1 for Gnumeric but product_task_selector returns ALLOWED
bypasses.repair: Call authority_gate_validation.py from _get_format_authority_status(); block P<4 without exception; remove hard-coded catalog

bypasses.name: authority_integration_fabric.py Not Wired
bypasses.location: Not imported anywhere in production path
bypasses.mechanism: File exists, imports tools/requirements_authority/ layer. Never imported by autonomous_cycle.py or supervisor_loop.py.
bypasses.impact: Proof graph never updated per sprint. Overclaims never detected. Requirements authority layer completely dormant.
bypasses.repair: Add Step 0b-authority-state in autonomous_cycle.py calling authority_integration_fabric

bypasses.name: Evidence Schema Missing spec_fact_refs
bypasses.mechanism: spec_fact_refs not listed as required field. sprint_executor_validate.py cannot enforce presence.
bypasses.impact: Evidence declarations are schema-valid without any spec authority citations
bypasses.live_evidence: supervisor-worker-contract.md required fields list reviewed — spec_fact_refs absent
bypasses.repair: Add spec_fact_refs as required-or-explain field in contract and validation schema

bypasses.name: generate_next_worker_prompt No Spec Data Injection
bypasses.mechanism: READ_BEFORE_EXECUTION excludes sal-facts-{format}.json, workbench/ artifacts, requirement-packs/. Workers have no spec-derived requirements.
bypasses.impact: Product code lacks FACT-* citations; tests are happy-path only; no behavioral spec assertions
bypasses.live_evidence: READ_BEFORE_EXECUTION list reviewed — no spec artifacts present
bypasses.repair: Add sal-facts, verified-facts, requirement-packs to READ_BEFORE_EXECUTION; inject top-3 facts into prompt

bypasses.name: exception_classification Allows All Tier 2 Formats to Bypass V13
bypasses.mechanism: no_public_spec_available, schema_authority_available, legacy_backfill exceptions allow PRODUCT_SOURCE items to pass V13 without spec_fact_refs
bypasses.impact: 15/20 formats have legitimate exception paths. legacy_backfill is not permanent — should sunset.
bypasses.live_evidence: exception_classification field accepted by V13 for ABW, SYLK, DIF, TSV, Gnumeric, CSV, NDJSON, TOML, XCF, QOI
bypasses.repair: For no_public_spec and schema_authority: keep permanently. For legacy_backfill: set sunset date 2 sprints after T3 authorization completes for each format.
bypasses.notes: DESIGNED bypass for Tier 2 formats. The mechanism is correct. Only legacy_backfill needs sunsetting.
